description_en: Modifies the configurations of an endpoint group
description_zh: 修改终端节点组配置信息
kebab_example: aliyun ga update-endpoint-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --endpoint-group-id epg-bp1dmlohjjz4kqaun0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateEndpointGroup

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅取值cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can generate the token on your client. Make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The client token supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId is different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the endpoint group
parameters.help_zh: 终端节点组ID
parameters.name: endpoint_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the endpoint group.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length, and can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter or a Chinese character
parameters.help_zh:
终端节点组的名称。

名称长度为1~128个字符，以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the endpoint group.

The description can be up to 200 characters in length and cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh:
终端节点组描述信息。

描述长度最大200字符，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the endpoint group
parameters.help_zh: 终端节点组所属的地域ID
parameters.name: endpoint_group_region

parameters.help_en: The weight of the endpoint group when the listener is associated with multiple endpoint groups
parameters.help_zh: 监听有多个终端节点组时的权重
parameters.name: traffic_percentage

parameters.help_en: The interval between two consecutive health checks. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 1 to 50
parameters.help_zh: 健康检查的时间间隔。单位：秒。取值范围：1-50
parameters.name: health_check_interval_seconds

parameters.help_en: The health check path
parameters.help_zh: 健康检查路径
parameters.name: health_check_path

parameters.help_en: The health check port. Valid values: 1 to 65535
parameters.help_zh: 健康检查的端口。取值范围：1~65535
parameters.name: health_check_port

parameters.help_en:
The health check protocol. Valid values:

tcp or TCP: TCP.

http or HTTP: HTTP.

https or HTTPS: HTTPS
parameters.help_zh:
健康检查的协议。取值：

tcp或TCP：TCP协议。

http或HTTP：HTTP协议。

https或HTTPS：HTTPS协议
parameters.name: health_check_protocol

parameters.help_en:
The number of consecutive health checks that are required to change the health check status. This refers to the number of consecutive failed health checks required to change the status from healthy to unhealthy, or the number of consecutive successful health checks required to change the status from unhealthy to healthy.

Valid values: 2 to 10
parameters.help_zh:
针对健康检查状态变化所需要的连续健康检查次数，即从成功到失败的连续健康检查失败次数或从失败到成功的连续健康检查成功次数。

取值范围：2~10
parameters.name: threshold_count

fields.help_en: The API keys in the endpoint configurations
fields.name: api_keys

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable client IP address preservation by using the automatic retrieval method. Valid values:

true: enables client IP address preservation.

false (default): disables client IP address preservation.

By default, client IP address preservation is disabled for endpoint groups associated with UDP or TCP listeners. You can configure this feature based on your business requirements.
By default, client IP address preservation is enabled for endpoint groups associated with HTTP or HTTPS listeners. The client IP addresses are obtained through the X-Forwarded-For header field. You cannot disable this feature.
You cannot set both EnableClientIPPreservation and EnableProxyProtocol to true.
For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158080.html
fields.help_zh:
是否使用自动获取方式开启保持客户端源 IP 功能，取值：

true：开启保持客户端源 IP 功能。

false（默认值）：不开启保持客户端源IP功能。


UDP/TCP 监听对应的终端节点组默认不开启保持客户端源IP，您可根据业务需要配置。
HTTP（S）监听对应的终端节点组默认开启保持客户端源IP，通过X-Forwarded-For头字段获取。不支持关闭。
EnableClientIPPreservation与 EnableProxyProtocol不能同时为 true。
更多信息请参考https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158080.html
fields.name: enable_client_ip_preservation

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable client IP address preservation by using the Proxy Protocol. Valid values:

true: enables client IP address preservation.

false (default): disables client IP address preservation.
This parameter is supported only for endpoint groups associated with TCP listeners.
You cannot set both EnableClientIPPreservation and EnableProxyProtocol to true.
For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158080.html
fields.help_zh:
是否使用ProxyProtocol方式开启保持客户端源IP功能，取值：

true：开启保持客户端源IP功能。

false（默认值）：不开启保持客户端源IP功能。
仅支持TCP监听对应的终端节点组配置。
EnableClientIPPreservation与 EnableProxyProtocol不能同时为 true。
更多信息请参考https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158080.html
fields.name: enable_proxy_protocol

fields.help_en: The IP address, domain name, or instance ID of the endpoint. Specify this parameter based on the endpoint type
fields.help_zh: 根据Type（终端节点类型）输入对应的IP、域名或实例ID
fields.name: endpoint

fields.help_en: The service provider in the endpoint configurations
fields.help_zh: 端点配置中的服务提供商
fields.name: provider

fields.help_en:
The private IP address of the elastic network interface controller (NIC).

This parameter is optional when the endpoint type is set to ENI. If you do not specify this parameter, the primary private IP address of the ENI is used by default
fields.help_zh:
弹性网卡的私网IP地址。

当终端节点类型为ENI时，可以选择配置该参数，如果不配置默认为ENI的主私网IP地址
fields.name: sub_address

fields.help_en:
The endpoint type. Valid values:
Domain: custom domain name.
Ip: custom IP address.
IpTarget: custom private IP.
PublicIp: Alibaba Cloud public IP address.
ECS: Alibaba Cloud ECS instance.
SLB: Alibaba Cloud SLB instance.
ALB: Alibaba Cloud ALB instance.
OSS: Alibaba Cloud OSS instance.
ENI: Alibaba Cloud elastic network interface controller (NIC).
NLB: Alibaba Cloud NLB instance.

If the endpoint type is set to ECS, ENI, SLB, ALB, NLB, or IpTarget and the service-linked role does not exist, the system automatically creates a service-linked role named AliyunServiceRoleForGaVpcEndpoint.
If the endpoint type is set to ALB and the service-linked role does not exist, the system automatically creates a service-linked role named AliyunServiceRoleForGaAlb.
If the endpoint type is set to OSS and the service-linked role does not exist, the system automatically creates a service-linked role named AliyunServiceRoleForGaOss.
If the endpoint type is set to NLB and the service-linked role does not exist, the system automatically creates a service-linked role named AliyunServiceRoleForGaNlb.
For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/178360.html
fields.help_zh:
终端节点类型，取值：
Domain：自定义域名。
Ip：自定义IP。
IpTarget：自定义私网IP。
PublicIp：阿里云公网IP。
ECS：阿里云ECS实例。
SLB：阿里云SLB实例。
ALB：阿里云ALB实例。
OSS：阿里云OSS实例。
ENI：阿里云弹性网卡。
NLB：阿里云NLB实例。

终端节点类型取值为ECS、ENI、SLB、ALB、NLB或IpTarget时，如果服务关联角色不存在，系统会自动创建一个名称为AliyunServiceRoleForGaVpcEndpoint的服务关联角色。
终端节点类型取值为ALB时，如果服务关联角色不存在，系统会自动创建一个名称为AliyunServiceRoleForGaAlb的服务关联角色。
终端节点类型取值为OSS时，如果服务关联角色不存在，系统会自动创建一个名称为AliyunServiceRoleForGaOss的服务关联角色。
终端节点类型取值为NLB时，如果服务关联角色不存在，系统会自动创建一个名称为AliyunServiceRoleForGaNlb的服务关联角色。
更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/178360.html
fields.name: type

fields.help_en:
The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC).

You can specify at most one VPC ID for an endpoint group associated with an intelligent routing listener.
This parameter is required and takes effect only when the endpoint type is set to IpTarget
fields.help_zh:
专有网络ID。

在智能路由类型监听的某个终端节点组中，您最多可以输入1个专有网络ID。
仅当终端节点类型为IpTarget时有效且必填
fields.name: vpc_id

fields.help_en:
The weight of the endpoint.

Valid values: 0 to 255.

If the weight of an endpoint is set to 0, Global Accelerator stops distributing traffic to the endpoint. Proceed with caution
fields.help_zh:
终端节点的权重。

取值范围：0~255。

如果某个终端节点的权重设置为0，全球加速将终止向该终端节点分发流量，请您谨慎操作
fields.name: weight

parameters.help_en: The endpoint configurations
parameters.help_zh: 终端节点配置信息
parameters.name: endpoint_configurations

parameters.help_en:
The backend service Terms of Service. Valid values:

HTTP
HTTPS

This parameter is supported only when you create an endpoint group for an HTTP or HTTPS listener instance.
For an HTTP listener instance, the backend service Terms of Service supports only HTTP
parameters.help_zh:
后端服务协议。取值：

HTTP
HTTPS

仅为HTTP或HTTPS协议的监听实例创建终端节点组时才支持配置该项。
对于HTTP协议的监听实例，后端服务协议支持且仅支持HTTP
parameters.name: endpoint_request_protocol

parameters.help_en:
The backend service Terms of Service version. Valid values:

HTTP1.1

HTTP2

You can specify the backend service Terms of Service version only when the EndpointRequestProtocol parameter is set to HTTPS
parameters.help_zh:
后端服务协议版本。取值：

HTTP1.1

HTTP2

仅当EndpointRequestProtocol（后端服务协议）值为HTTPS时，支持配置终端节点后端服务协议版本
parameters.name: endpoint_protocol_version

fields.help_en: The endpoint port in the port mapping
fields.help_zh: 配置端口映射中的终端节点端口
fields.name: endpoint_port

fields.help_en:
The listener port in the port mapping.

For TCP listeners: Port mappings are not supported for virtual endpoint groups. If a virtual endpoint group already exists under the listener, you cannot configure port mappings for the default endpoint group. If port mappings are already configured for the default endpoint group, you cannot add a virtual endpoint group.
After you configure port mappings, the following limits apply to subsequent listener modifications: You cannot modify the listener protocol, except for switching between HTTP and HTTPS.
Listener port: The modified listener port range must include all listener ports in the current port mappings. For example, if the listener port range is 80 to 82 and the port mappings are configured to map to endpoint ports 100 to 102, you cannot change the listener port range to 80 to 81
fields.help_zh:
配置端口映射中的监听端口。

对于TCP监听：虚拟终端节点组不支持配置端口映射。如果监听下已存在虚拟终端节点组，则默认终端节点组无法配置端口映射。如果默认终端节点组已配置端口映射，则无法添加虚拟终端节点组。
配置端口映射后，后续监听变更时有以下限制：除HTTP和HTTPS之间的协议切换以外，不支持修改监听协议。
监听端口：您修改的监听端口范围必须包含当前所配置端口映射的全量监听端口。例如，当监听端口范围为80-82，并配置端口映射至终端节点端口100-102时，后续修改监听端口范围时，不支持修改为80-81
fields.name: listener_port

Specifies whether to enable health checks. Valid values:
true: enables health checks.
false (default): disables health checks
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启健康检查。取值：
true：开启健康检查。

parameters.help_en:
The IP version of the backend IP address. Valid values:
IPv4 (default): GA communicates with the endpoint service only over IPv4.
IPv6: GA communicates with the endpoint service only over IPv6.
ProtocolAffinity: GA communicates with the endpoint service over the same IP version as the client request
parameters.help_zh:
后端IP地址协议。取值：
● IPv4（默认值）：GA仅使用IPv4地址与终端节点服务通信。
● IPv6：GA仅使用IPv6地址与终端节点服务通信。
● ProtocolAffinity：GA与终端节点服务通信的IP协议与客户端请求使用的IP协议相同
